```{r echo = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

# Load data
sal <- read_csv(paste0(
  "https://stat.cmu.edu/~sgallagh/courses/mads-fall-2026/",
  "datavis-36613/data/salaries.csv.gz"
))
```

## Data Cleaning

```{r echo = FALSE}
sal <- sal |>
  mutate(
    experience_level = factor(
      experience_level,
      levels = c("EX", "SE", "MI", "EN"),
      labels = c("Executive", "Senior", "Mid", "Entry")
    ),
    
    remote = case_when(
      remote_ratio == 0 ~ "On-Site",
      remote_ratio == 50 ~ "Hybrid",
      remote_ratio == 100 ~ "Fully remote"
    ),
    
    remote = factor(
      remote,
      levels = c("On-Site", "Hybrid", "Fully remote")
    ),
    
    log_salary = log(salary_in_usd)
  ) |>
  filter(employment_type == "FT")
```

## Job Title Grouping

```{r echo = FALSE}
sal <- sal |>
  mutate(
    role_group = case_when(

      # Data Science
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "data scientist|decision scientist|applied scientist"
      ) ~ "Data Science",

      # AI / Machine Learning
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "machine learning|\\bml\\b|artificial intelligence|\\bai\\b|nlp|computer vision|deep learning|llm|prompt"
      ) ~ "AI / Machine Learning",

      # Data Engineering / Infrastructure
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "data engineer|data architect|dataops|data infrastructure|data platform|data integration|etl|data pipeline|data developer"
      ) ~ "Data Engineering / Infrastructure",

      # Analytics / BI
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "analyst|analytics|business intelligence|\\bbi\\b|power bi|data analysis|reporting|data visualization"
      ) ~ "Analytics / BI",

      # Research / Quantitative
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "research|quantitative|statistician|statistical|computational scientist|economist|actuar|postdoctoral"
      ) ~ "Research / Quantitative",

      # Management / Product
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "manager|director|head of|product manager|product owner|data lead|analytics lead"
      ) ~ "Management / Product",

      # Software / Systems Engineering
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "software|developer|engineer|devops|platform|site reliability|systems|system engineer|architect|technical lead|tech lead"
      ) ~ "Software / Systems Engineering",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

sal |>
  count(role_group, sort = TRUE)
```







```{r fig-career-dashboard}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| out-width: 100%

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
library(htmltools)

# ---------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare data
# ---------------------------------------

experience_levels <- c(
  "Entry", "Mid", "Senior", "Executive"
)

sizes <- c(
  "All Companies", "Small", "Medium", "Large"
)

colors <- c(
  Entry = "#249B83",
  Mid = "#E58A45",
  Senior = "#5278B7",
  Executive = "#9B70AD"
)

salary_data <- sal |>
  mutate(
    experience_level = factor(
      as.character(experience_level),
      levels = experience_levels
    ),
    company_size = factor(
      as.character(company_size),
      levels = c("S", "M", "L"),
      labels = c("Small", "Medium", "Large")
    )
  )

# Annual median salary by company size
career_size <- salary_data |>
  group_by(
    work_year,
    company_size,
    experience_level
  ) |>
  summarise(
    median_salary = median(
      salary_in_usd, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n = sum(!is.na(salary_in_usd)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 5) |>
  mutate(
    company_size = as.character(company_size)
  )

# Overall annual median salaries
career_all <- salary_data |>
  group_by(work_year, experience_level) |>
  summarise(
    median_salary = median(
      salary_in_usd, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n = sum(!is.na(salary_in_usd)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 5) |>
  mutate(company_size = "All Companies")

career_plot <- bind_rows(
  career_all,
  career_size
)

# ---------------------------------------
# 2. Salary progression table (2024–2025)
# ---------------------------------------

career_gains <- salary_data |>
  filter(
    work_year %in% c(2024, 2025),
    !is.na(salary_in_usd)
  ) |>
  group_by(company_size, experience_level) |>
  summarise(
    median_salary = median(salary_in_usd),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    median_salary = if_else(
      n >= 5,
      median_salary,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  select(-n) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = experience_level,
    values_from = median_salary
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Entry_Mid = (Mid - Entry) / Entry,
    Mid_Senior = (Senior - Mid) / Mid,
    Senior_Executive =
      (Executive - Senior) / Senior
  ) |>
  arrange(company_size)

# Formatting functions
fmt_salary <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "N/A",
    dollar(x, accuracy = 1)
  )
}

fmt_pct <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "N/A",
    percent(x, accuracy = 0.1)
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------
# 3. Interactive salary progression graph
# ---------------------------------------

fig <- plot_ly()

trace_sizes <- character()
trace_levels <- character()

for (size in sizes) {

  for (level in experience_levels) {

    df <- career_plot |>
      filter(
        company_size == size,
        experience_level == level
      ) |>
      arrange(work_year)

    if (nrow(df) == 0) next

    fig <- fig |>
      add_trace(
        data = df,
        x = ~work_year,
        y = ~median_salary,

        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",

        name = paste(level, "Level"),
        legendgroup = level,

        showlegend = size == "All Companies",
        visible = size == "All Companies",

        line = list(
          color = unname(colors[level]),
          width = 3
        ),

        marker = list(
          color = unname(colors[level]),
          size = 8
        ),

        text = ~paste0(
          "<b>", experience_level, " Level</b>",
          "<br>Year: ", work_year,
          "<br>Company size: ", company_size,
          "<br>Median salary: ",
          dollar(median_salary),
          "<br>Records: ", comma(n)
        ),

        hoverinfo = "text"
      )

    trace_sizes <- c(trace_sizes, size)
    trace_levels <- c(trace_levels, level)
  }
}

fig <- plotly_build(fig)

# ---------------------------------------
# 4. Professional salary progression table
# ---------------------------------------

table_headers <- c(
  "<b>Company<br>Size</b>",
  "<b>Entry<br>Level</b>",
  "<b>Mid<br>Level</b>",
  "<b>Senior<br>Level</b>",
  "<b>Executive<br>Level</b>",
  "<b>Entry to<br>Mid (%)</b>",
  "<b>Mid to<br>Senior (%)</b>",
  "<b>Senior to<br>Executive (%)</b>"
)

for (size in sizes) {

  df <- if (size == "All Companies") {
    career_gains
  } else {
    career_gains |>
      filter(as.character(company_size) == size)
  }

  # Alternating white and gray-blue rows
  row_colors <- if (size == "All Companies") {
    c("#FFFFFF", "#F3F6FA", "#FFFFFF")
  } else {
    "#FFFFFF"
  }

  fig <- fig |>
    add_trace(
      type = "table",
      inherit = FALSE,

      domain = list(
        x = c(0.02, 0.98),
        y = c(0.07, 0.30)
      ),

      columnwidth = c(
        105, 105, 105, 105,
        110, 105, 110, 120
      ),

      header = list(
        values = table_headers,
        align = "center",

        fill = list(
          color = "#344256"
        ),

        font = list(
          color = "white",
          size = 12
        ),

        line = list(
          color = "#DCE3EB",
          width = 1
        ),

        height = 48
      ),

      cells = list(
        values = list(
          as.character(df$company_size),
          fmt_salary(df$Entry),
          fmt_salary(df$Mid),
          fmt_salary(df$Senior),
          fmt_salary(df$Executive),
          fmt_pct(df$Entry_Mid),
          fmt_pct(df$Mid_Senior),
          fmt_pct(df$Senior_Executive)
        ),

        align = "center",

        fill = list(
          color = rep(
            list(row_colors),
            length(table_headers)
          )
        ),

        font = list(
          color = "#243247",
          size = 12
        ),

        line = list(
          color = "#E0E6EE",
          width = 1
        ),

        height = 38
      ),

      visible = size == "All Companies",
      showlegend = FALSE
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------
# 5. Dropdown controls graph and table
# ---------------------------------------

n_lines <- length(trace_sizes)

buttons <- lapply(seq_along(sizes), function(i) {

  size <- sizes[i]

  line_visible <- trace_sizes == size
  table_visible <- seq_along(sizes) == i

  legend_visible <- rep(FALSE, n_lines)
  shown_levels <- character()

  for (j in seq_len(n_lines)) {

    if (
      line_visible[j] &&
      !(trace_levels[j] %in% shown_levels)
    ) {

      legend_visible[j] <- TRUE

      shown_levels <- c(
        shown_levels,
        trace_levels[j]
      )
    }
  }

  list(
    label = size,
    method = "update",

    args = list(
      list(
        visible = c(
          line_visible,
          table_visible
        ),

        showlegend = c(
          legend_visible,
          rep(FALSE, length(sizes))
        )
      ),

      list(
        title = list(
          text = paste0(
            "Median Annual Salary by Experience Level, ",
            "2020–2025"
          ),
          x = 0.02,
          xanchor = "left",
          font = list(
            size = 19,
            color = "#14213D"
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
})

# ---------------------------------------
# 6. Dashboard layout
# ---------------------------------------

fig <- fig |>
  layout(

    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        "Median Annual Salary by Experience Level, ",
        "2020–2025"
      ),
      x = 0.02,
      xanchor = "left",
      font = list(
        size = 19,
        color = "#14213D"
      )
    ),

    paper_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",
    plot_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",

    xaxis = list(
      title = "Year",
      dtick = 1,
      range = c(2019.8, 2025.2),

      domain = c(0.07, 0.81),

      tickfont = list(
        color = "#52627A",
        size = 12
      ),

      titlefont = list(
        color = "#52627A",
        size = 13
      ),

      gridcolor = "#E9EEF4",
      zeroline = FALSE,
      showline = FALSE
    ),

    yaxis = list(
      title = "Median Annual Salary (USD)",
      tickprefix = "$",
      tickformat = ",.0f",

      domain = c(0.47, 0.88),

      tickfont = list(
        color = "#52627A",
        size = 12
      ),

      titlefont = list(
        color = "#52627A",
        size = 13
      ),

      gridcolor = "#E9EEF4",
      zeroline = FALSE,
      showline = FALSE
    ),

    legend = list(
      x = 0.84,
      y = 0.86,

      bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",

      font = list(
        size = 12,
        color = "#243247"
      ),

      tracegroupgap = 10
    ),

    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        buttons = buttons,
        direction = "down",

        x = 0.02,
        y = 1.01,

        xanchor = "left",
        yanchor = "top",

        showactive = TRUE,

        bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",
        bordercolor = "#CBD5E1",
        borderwidth = 1,

        font = list(
          color = "#243247",
          size = 12
        )
      )
    ),

    annotations = list(

      # Graph subtitle
      list(
        text = paste0(
          "Median annual salary in USD; ",
          "minimum 5 records per plotted point"
        ),

        x = 0.02,
        y = 0.94,

        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",

        xanchor = "left",
        showarrow = FALSE,

        font = list(
          size = 12,
          color = "#64748B"
        )
      ),

      # Table title
      list(
        text = paste0(
          "<b>Career Salary Progression ",
          "by Company Size, 2024–2025</b>"
        ),

        x = 0.5,
        y = 0.385,

        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",

        showarrow = FALSE,

        font = list(
          size = 18,
          color = "#14213D"
        )
      ),

      # Table subtitle
      list(
        text = paste0(
          "Median annual salaries and percentage ",
          "differences between experience levels"
        ),

        x = 0.5,
        y = 0.35,

        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",

        showarrow = FALSE,

        font = list(
          size = 12,
          color = "#64748B"
        )
      ),

      # Footnote
      list(
        text = paste0(
          "Note: Table values combine 2024–2025 data. ",
          "Percentage differences compare experience ",
          "groups, not individual salary increases. ",
          "N/A indicates insufficient data."
        ),

        x = 0.5,
        y = 0.025,

        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",

        showarrow = FALSE,

        font = list(
          size = 11,
          color = "#64748B"
        )
      )
    ),

    height = 950,
    autosize = TRUE,

    margin = list(
      t = 95,
      b = 20,
      l = 90,
      r = 25
    ),

    hovermode = "closest"
  ) |>
  config(
    responsive = TRUE,
    displayModeBar = "hover"
  )

# ---------------------------------------
# 7. Dashboard heading and display
# ---------------------------------------

dashboard <- tagList(

  tags$div(
    style = paste(
      "font-family: Arial, sans-serif;",
      "margin-bottom: 16px;"
    ),

    tags$h2(
      style = paste(
        "color: #14213D;",
        "font-size: 30px;",
        "font-weight: 700;",
        "margin-bottom: 8px;"
      ),

      "Career Progression & Experience"
    ),

    tags$p(
      style = paste(
        "color: #64748B;",
        "font-size: 15px;",
        "line-height: 1.6;"
      ),

      paste(
        "Explore median annual salaries across",
        "experience levels and company sizes,",
        "along with salary differences between",
        "career stages."
      )
    )
  ),

  tags$div(
    style = paste(
      "border: 1px solid #E2E8F0;",
      "border-radius: 10px;",
      "padding: 12px;",
      "background: #FFFFFF;"
    ),

    fig
  )
)

browsable(dashboard)
```
